top_signals.title: China Bonds Buck Global Selloff on Policy Divide With Peers
top_signals.summary: A relentless drop in China’s long-end yields is driving an aggressive curve flattening, laying bare a stark macro rift with global markets where long-dated rates have hit multi-year peaks.

top_signals.title: JBS Seeks Rest of Pilgrim’s Pride Stake in $1.2 Billion Deal
top_signals.summary: Pilgrim’s Pride Corp. shares jumped after meatpacking giant JBS NV offered to acquire the shares of the chicken producer it doesn’t already own in a stock deal valued at about $1.2 billion.
